display.purpose: The page title, one per page, from 48rem up.

display-sm.purpose: The page title below 48rem, and on the sign-in and register pages at every width.

headline.purpose: Titles of list sections on the home page, the title of an empty page and of the example board.

title-lg.purpose: Dialog and sheet titles, project names in the project list, and the wordmark.

title.purpose: Section heads in the minutes and the task sheet, lane heads, and the head of the notification list and the people list.

summary.purpose: The meeting summary only: the one piece of running text set in Besley.

body.purpose: The default for everything. Running paragraphs open up to a line height of 1.625.

body-sm.purpose: Second lines: the index line under a board title, row details, role labels and captions.

label-lg.purpose: Button labels, tab labels, task titles, names in lists and text links.

label.purpose: Field labels, small buttons and segmented options.

caption.purpose: Hints, counts, timestamps and item numbers.

micro.purpose: The due date in a task's margin and the letters in the standard initials box.

badge.purpose: The smallest step: the digits in a count badge and the letters in the small initials box.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the build. Dialogs, sheets, menus and the mention list, always with a 1px Heavy Rule border. The same value in both themes.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover, press and selection. The same timing fades a dragged row to 40% and turns a section's chevron a quarter turn.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: A text link's underline darkens from Heavy Rule to ink on hover.

motion.name: strike
motion.purpose: Ticking a task draws a 1px line through its title from the left while the text fades to Faint Ink.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Entrance for centred dialogs, menus and the mention list: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 6px to 0.

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: Entrance for the sheet: opacity 0 to 1 and translateX 14px to 0.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The spinner in a busy button and on the full page loader.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation and transition duration is forced to 1ms and smooth scrolling is turned off.

narrative.overview:
TranscribeBoard is drawn as a bound book of meeting minutes. The page is white, the ink is blue-black, the lines are pale blue, and one red rule marks the margin. A board is a ruled sheet of numbered entries. Each task keeps its number and its due date in the margin, left of the red rule, with its tick box, title and priority mark to the right. The record of the meeting (summary, decisions, blockers, risks, dependencies and open questions) sits beside the tasks as numbered items on the same page.

The system is compact and flat. Body text is 0.875rem, default controls are 2.25rem tall, and lists are rows divided by 1px rules. Nothing in the page casts a shadow: structure comes from rules and two pale washes. Colour is close to monochrome. Ink carries text, filled buttons, selection and focus. Red is kept for the margin rule and for whatever needs attention or cannot be undone. Two typefaces split the work: Besley, a Clarendon serif, names things, and Public Sans runs the controls and the data.

The dark theme is a carbon copy of the same page: every colour token has a dark value under the `.dark` class, and no component carries a dark-only style. Motion is brief and tied to a change of state. Colours change in 150ms, a ticked task has a line drawn through its title in 200ms, and overlays rise or slide in over 160ms to 200ms. When the reader asks for reduced motion, every duration drops to 1ms. The owner has ruled out two looks: the dense grey tables of an enterprise suite, and generic generated UI.
keyCharacteristics: A white page, blue-black ink, pale blue 1px rules and one red margin rule.
Lists are ruled rows, not cards. Nothing in the page casts a shadow.
Numbers and dates keep fixed columns and tabular figures.
Besley names things. Public Sans runs controls and data. Weights are 400, 500 and 600 only.
2px corners, 1px borders and one 2px ink focus ring.
One shadow, used only by overlays.
The dark theme remaps every token and changes nothing else.
Ticking a task draws a line through its title.

rules.name: The Red Ink Rule
rules.body: Red has two jobs and no others. It draws the margin rule, and it writes what needs attention or cannot be undone: an overdue date, a blocker, an unread count, an error, the offline notice, a destructive action. A red element that is neither is wrong.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Components never name a colour by value. The framework's default palette is switched off, so the only colours that exist are the theme tokens, and both themes follow from them. The one dark-only declaration in the build sits in the base styles and inverts the browser's date picker icon.

rules.name: The Binding Colour Rule
rules.body: The eight binding colours identify a project and do nothing else. They never colour text, controls or status.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Besley is for names: of a page, a section, a lane, a project, a plan and a dialog, and for the summary. Public Sans is for controls, data and interface text. A name stays in Besley even when it is also a link or a toggle.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400, 500 and 600 are used. Besley is always 600, except the summary at 400. There is no 700 and no italic.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that line up or change in place are set in tabular figures: item numbers, due dates, counts, clock times and prices.

rules.name: The Ruled Row Rule
rules.body: Collections are divided by rules, never boxed into cards. A list is a column of rows, each closed by a 1px Ledger Rule, and a row that leads somewhere washes as a whole on hover.

rules.name: The Fixed Places Rule
rules.body: What is compared down a list keeps one column. The 3.25rem margin of a task row holds its number and due date, the task rollup gives the date a 3.5rem column, and the project list gives boards, open tasks and last update their own right-aligned columns (6rem, 7rem and 6rem).

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing that sits in the page casts a shadow. Only a surface that floats above the page takes the overlay shadow, and it always takes the Heavy Rule border with it.

rules.name: The Two Pixel Rule
rules.body: Controls and containers turn their corners by 2px and no more. A fully round shape means a dot, a count or a meter track, never a button or a tag.

dos: Do take every colour from the theme tokens in `src/index.css`, so the light page and its dark carbon copy change together.
Do close a page head (title, lead and actions) with the double rule: 3px double, in ink, 1rem below the block.
Do build lists as rows closed by a 1px Ledger Rule, and open a list that stands as its own section with a 1px ink rule.
Do give numbers and dates a fixed column and tabular figures, as the 3.25rem task margin does.
Do set names in Besley at 600, and everything operated, counted or dated in Public Sans.
Do keep controls to the shared heights: 2.25rem, 2rem for the small size, and 2.75rem on a coarse pointer.
Do show focus with the one ring: a 2px ink outline 2px clear of the control, drawn inward inside a bordered group.
Do mark a finished task by drawing the 1px line through its title and dropping it to Faint Ink.
Do keep state changes quick: 150ms for colour, 200ms for the line through a ticked task, and the 160ms rise or the 200ms slide for an overlay.
donts: Don't put a shadow on anything that sits in the page. The overlay shadow is for dialogs, sheets, menus and the mention list only.
Don't use red for emphasis or decoration. It is the margin rule, and the ink of attention and of actions that cannot be undone.
Don't use a binding colour for text, controls or status. It only says which project a thing belongs to.
Don't add a second status hue. Success and information share the Pale Wash notice and differ by icon; only attention is red.
Don't name a colour by value in a component, and don't add dark-only overrides.
Don't wrap list items in cards or give rows their own boxes.
Don't round a control or a container by more than 2px. Full rounding is for dots, count badges and the meter track.
Don't use weight 700, italics, capitals or letter spacing for emphasis. Emphasis is weight 600, or ink against Second Ink.
Don't animate layout, and don't stage rows, sections or pages with entrance animation. The rise and the slide belong to overlays, and nothing lifts, scales or glows on hover.
